description: Terrain materials: KL201 without clients mod, KL330 past the 11 terrain ids (apart from the building materials' 49), a field a terrain material doesn't have. Good ones say nothing else.

diagnostics.message: terrain material "frost-ore" needs "clients": "mod", and this mod says "kiln": cells reach players as ids, so kiln.worldtables refuses it
This mod has 13 terrain materials, and the game has ids for 11: kiln.worldtables refuses those past that by name, starting from the last in sorted GUID order ("frost-ore" is one of this mod's)
"shine" is not allowed here (allowed: comment, description, flatten, icon, like, look, name, placeable, recipe, sliding, strength, was)
